name: Gaseous Form
description:
Concentration, up to 1 hour.

You transform, along with everything you’re wearing and carrying, into a misty cloud. Roll Lore to determine any additional effects.

In this form, you can fly, your Speed is 10 ft, and you can pass through small holes and cracks, but you can’t speak, manipulate objects, attack, or cast spells. You automatically win Engagement, and any rolls you are forced to make by other creatures’ abilities are favored.

If you take any damage, the spell ends.
successes:
✨: Your Speed increases by 10 ft.

🌞: While the spell lasts, you may spend an action to move between your gaseous and natural forms.

💀: Check a Condition. You are transformed, but you cannot propel yourself and are at the mercy of air currents, which push you through the air as defined by the GM. The effect lasts for 10 minutes, then ends.
